ontology.note: The semantic contract belongs to the ruleset, which declares its own output vocabulary and basis; do not infer one from this widget.

changes.description: A column the rules read can be a date, written year-month-day. One date minus another gives days, stated as the new column's unit: a serial interval, or a 7-1-7 interval. Any other arithmetic with a date, or a date compared with a number, is refused while the rule is written; a date that is not a real day is unreadable, never moved to the next month (experiment 200).

evidence.note: Repository regression coverage exists, and the Validation Lab checks this widget exhaustively rather than by sample -- check 23 enumerates the complete input space of all three bundled rulesets, 46 cells, reproducing every conclusion with an independent decision table and verifying the emitted receipt. That is evidence about the rulesets and about this widget's four stages; it does not certify the widget independently, and it says nothing about whether any threshold is right.
